decision: The user explicitly chose management of the existing bundled system-audio helper instead of a separately installed companion application.
implementation: Typed main-owned status distinguishes unavailable, stopped, starting, running and safe error reasons. Settings reads status without starting capture; web capability explanations report unsupported rather than pretending a native helper exists.

Explicit diagnostic start discards captured PCM and never emits the screen-share capture IPC stream. A main-generated UUID stop token protects each diagnostic run. Diagnostics cannot steal a live share, screen sharing may preempt diagnostics, and old diagnostic cleanup cannot stop the new owner.

Settings polling and actions use request/mount generations; delayed status responses cannot overwrite newer actions. Unmount stops only the view's own run, including a start that completes late. Failed/invalid initial app-settings reads show recoverable retry instead of fake saved defaults.

Installation, repair and removal remain part of the HiChat application installer. There is no separate fake install/uninstall flow. The existing bundled native/audio-capture.exe is present and included by the existing extraResources configuration.
